result.summary: The page layout is largely sound, but the 'Popular right now' section shows a stuck loading spinner overlaid on an image that has already rendered, plus minor inconsistencies in the favorite button styling between cards.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' displays a circular loading spinner in the center of its hero image, even though the image itself is fully rendered behind it. The stuck/leftover spinner obscures the food photo and suggests the card is still loading.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator once the image onload event fires (and on error), and ensure the spinner is not rendered on top of already-loaded imagery.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use inconsistent styling: the first is a dark outline heart on a white circular background, the second is a white heart on a dark/transparent circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment (same background, icon color and size) across all restaurant cards.
